fullPassage: It was the last day of school before summer vacation. After months of quizzes and assignments, I couldn't wait to leave everything behind. Could anything be sweeter? I practically danced while cleaning out my locker, and nothing could ruin my mood. As I zipped up my backpack, ready to leave, my science teacher, Mr. Manta, called me aside. "Rafe," he said, "you haven't turned in your final lab report, despite all my warnings this past month." The words hit me like cold water. He was right, but I totally forgot about it. "To make up for it, you must attend summer school," he added. Instead of lazy mornings and endless free time, I'd be spending my vacation at a lab table — the last thing I wanted to do with my precious summer.
title: A Ruined Summer Vacation
